name: Lord Blain
source:
Nation: Corval

“But you are interested in her?!?!?!"

The bitter young lord of Corval is both possessive and tactless, leading you to wonder if he was sent to the summit in hopes he would anger someone enough that his enemies at home wouldn’t have to kill him themselves. He winds up really not liking the Protagonist very quickly.
